scenes.say: Eyes tired after using your phone all day? Try the twenty, twenty, twenty rule.
Every twenty minutes of screen time,
look at something twenty feet away,
for twenty seconds, and blink often. This relaxes your eye's focusing muscles.

scenes.en: Still headaches or blurry vision? Get an eye test.
scenes.say: If you still get headaches or blurred vision, it's time for an eye test.
